summary: # Marvelous Designer Official 2023 User Conference ## Speaker Introduction Thank you very much, Sherry, for your introduction of new features. I believe that through her introduction, more users will be able to utilize our new version and features. At the same time, if you have any questions about our products in the future, you can follow our Bilibili account, MP official, and our WeChat official account, Marley Designer. You can get a lot of help and information through these two channels. Next, we will invite another very professional female teacher to share her knowledge on how to use Marley Designer to make equipment. Let's give a round of applause to Zhang Jinbao, a high-end 3D artist from Nanjing Weijin Technology Company. Welcome! --- ## Speaker's Personal Experience Hello, everyone. I am Xu Zhexing. I am very happy to be here to share with you my personal experience in the production of the project. I would like to thank you all for your continued support. --- ## Insights on Equipment Modeling ### Case Study Analysis First, I would like to share insights through two case studies. The first is the ancient-style dual-layer clothing, and the second is a realistic feathered garment. #### Ancient-Style Dual-Layer Clothing 1. **Analyzing the Original Artwork**: When creating the ancient-style dual-layer clothing, I directly referenced the high model from "Ghost of Tsushima" for MD production. However, this approach has its differences, primarily in design. 2. **Finding References**: - **Method 1**: Search on Taobao. - **Method 2**: Purchase raw materials from the official MD store. - **Method 3**: Find high-end references from real clothes and similar patterns online. 3. **Using T-Shirt Patterns**: Modify T-shirt patterns to create the ancient style. The process includes: - Finding a basic T-shirt panel in the software. - If no panel exists, adjust it to the original. - Initially, focus on creating a basic shape before refining details. 4. **Adding Details**: - Identify which details to create in MD and which to add in ZB. - Ensure the color of the clothing matches the model accurately. 5. **Optimizing Folds**: This step is crucial. Use fixed needles to achieve the desired shapes, adjusting values to maintain overall aesthetics without compromising the design. --- ## Modern vs. Ancient Clothing ### Differences in Production The differences between ancient and modern clothing are notable. Modern clothes focus more on patterns and body structure, while ancient costumes often have a monotone aesthetic with less emphasis on pattern complexity. ### Production Techniques - **Modern Clothing**: Generally, it’s more fitted to the body. The patterns are often more complex and detailed. - **Ancient Clothing**: Tends to be larger and less fitted, focusing on aesthetic details rather than structural intricacies. --- ## Final Remarks on Production Process ### Steps to Optimize Production 1. **Analyzing Styles**: Start with analysis and reference gathering. 2. **Creating Basic Shapes in MD**: Use resources effectively to save time and increase efficiency. 3. **Adding and Adjusting Details**: Focus on adding realistic details and modifying dimensions for better fit. 4. **Rendering Techniques**: After completing the MD process, move to ZB for further sculpting or rough rendering. ### New Version Features Discussing the features of the new MD-12 version: - **Image Line Editing**: This function allows for fast adjustments in the 3D window and is particularly useful for creating complex garments like diving suits. - **Remodeling Capabilities**: Enhances efficiency in the 3D stage of production. ### Learning Resources I highly recommend the official Bilibili video tutorials for detailed guidance on clothing board production. Engaging in the official learning path will greatly benefit those looking to improve their skills. --- ## Conclusion Thank you all for your attention. If you have any questions, feel free to ask. MD is a process that can enhance your modeling skills significantly. If there are no further questions, we will invite Professor Zhang to sit down first. Thank you for sharing!
